label: Stage-two spine rivals audited against the substantive objection standard
summary: Audit of the 24 stage-two rows of the modal spine rival table (10 root and act-of-being premises, 14 attribute and naming premises consumed by NecessaryClassicalGodRoot.derive and NecessaryClassicalGodRootFromUnderived.derive) against the substantive objection standard of 2026-11-12. Each rival already has a finite model in which it holds with the other premises of its consuming theorem and that theorem's conclusion fails (results of specs/spine-rivals-root-esse.toml and specs/spine-rivals-attributes.toml). Those models show where each premise is needed; they are not evidence against it, and the note's column semantics were corrected to say so. Method: for each rival, check the corpus for a sourced claim, verified result or read source that justifies its mechanism, and whether that mechanism bears on the premise as formalized; symmetrically, list the claims stating the premise and its derivations. No source was newly read; leads named below are from memory or from registered but unread sources, and carry no weight. Findings after the independent semantic challenge and repair (full table in docs/notes/modal-spine.md, section 'Stage two: objection audit'). Totals: 7 with support on file, all partial (none fully substantive), 1 misdirected, 16 formal alternatives with no substantive objection identified; no established counterexample. PARTIAL (7), each with a named open bridge: (1) whole-roster nontrapping vs infinitism: Welchance 2026 (read, passage WELCHANCE-INFINITISM-1-3) argues parity of an unexplained chain with an unexplained foundation; open bridges: his relata are facts under 'in virtue of', and he concludes parity, not truth. (2) contingent grounding vs existential inertia: Schmid (read, docs/eternity-dependence-connection.md) explains persistence by earlier existence and the absence of a destroying cause, with no concurrent sustainer; open bridge: whether grounding under m.grounds is concurrent sustenance by a distinct ground (if an earlier existent can be the ground, Schmid does not contest the premise). Hume I.3.3 (claim HUME-TREATISE-I-3-3-NARROW-A) argues only nondemonstrability. Oppy 2020 (read) is support neither way: every possible world shares the initial history (claim OPPY-2020-SHARED-LAWS-INITIAL-HISTORY), but that claim and DEF-OPPY-CAUSAL-MODAL-COMPARISON withhold numerical identity of one bearer across worlds, so whether his uncaused initial state is a necessary individual or a contingent ungrounded one is an unresolved bearer-identity bridge. (3) esse-cause concreteness bridge, on an analyst construction only: claim PLATO-PHAEDO-100D-PARTICIPATION-EXPLANATORY (explaining being so is not shown to be causing esse) and Rosen's report, without endorsement, of Lewis's events-as-sets (claim SEP-ABSTRACT-OBJECTS-32-LEWIS-EVENTS-ARE-SETS), with two stacked open bridges (causing events vs causing esse; impure sets non-concrete in the adopted sense). (4) uniting cause vs priority monism: Schaffer (claim SCHAFFER-14-BASIC-WHOLE) gives a basic composite whose parts depend on it, contesting the q.3 a.7 reason; open bridge: ungrounded is not uncaused in being. (5) immaterial-intellect: the recorded rival has two conjuncts; Papineau (claim PAPINEAU-RISE-CAUSAL-POWERS-PHYSICAL) supports at most 'intellect requires the physical', with the bridge physical to matter-form composite open, and nothing on file supports the second conjunct, an altogether immaterial non-intellectual thing. A further partial objection on file is not yet a recorded rival: Plotinus V.4.2 (claim PLOTINUS-V4-INTELLECT-NOT-FIRST) argues intellect is two, so the absolutely simple first is not intellect. Open sense bridge: its intellect is the Plotinian thinking/intelligible structure (DEF-PLOTINIAN-INTELLECT-DUALITY, DISAMB-PLOTINIAN-PRIORITY-UNITY), distinguished in the corpus from every account of cognition; nothing shows that stage two's primitive HasIntellect entails that duality. Only with that bridge would it target the joint simplicity and intellect conclusions, where it would be the most consequential stage-two objection. (6) act's priority: Aristotle's aporia (claim ARIST-MET-1071B-POTENCY-PRIOR-A) reaches simple priority only through an analyst reading step; ATTEMPT-NIGHT-COSMOGONY-BUNDLE-ELIMINATION records that its grounds constrain only ability and act, not PriorSimply. The Night bundle is excluded by a zero-axiom core Gamma of three open premises without the target, and the bare rival survives in MODEL-NIGHT-COSMOGONY-RESIDUAL. Open bridge: ability to simple priority. (7) naming: the rival is derived (argument a9b8530b) from the unattributed practice-use thesis WF-P1 plus two further open premises (proper application preserved by practice reference; existence of a satisfier of the full description); Phillips's secondhand-reported remark (claim SEP-RELIGIOUS-LANGUAGE-4-1-PHILLIPS-NO-OBJECT-A) supports but does not state WF-P1. The premise has four arguments: one from the reduced-description premise alone, two through GOD_2 and GOD_3 bridges, and a GOD_1 transcription. MISDIRECTED (1): the exceeded-god rival uses another sense of 'god' than GOD_4; GOD_4 is a primitive field whose content is fixed only by open premises, here STMT-GOD-HAS-CLASSICAL-DIVINE-ATTRIBUTES, so the misdirection holds only given that premise. FORMAL ALTERNATIVE ONLY, no substantive objection identified (16): concrete population; idle maximum; mere conservation; thin existence (its sense is fixed by definition f5345c9c; with one shared InAct and esse respect the thin view contests the bundle of existence-to-act, perfection transfer and infinity, not another sense; no sourced justification is on file); grades to a maximum (comparatives without a maximum are established but bear only on a general more-and-less rule that nothing on the route uses; both derivations are being-specific, and a general warrant would not suffice); non-concrete simple priority (the Phaedo claim says nothing about priority); actuality without being; strong emergence; goodness (Hume's is/ought and Moore's open question are unread leads; whether they concern GOOD_1 is not checked); esse-essence difference without composition (Scotus's formal distinction: unread, unverified lead); world-soul; intellect without will; act and potency in one respect; finite subsistent being (dispute lies upstream at STMT-ESSE-LIMITED-ONLY-THROUGH-RECEPTION); immutable without eternity (Shoemaker and Wolterstorff: unread, unverified leads); sufficiency of the nine attributes (no substantive objection identified; warrant gap: a stipulated bridge to the primitive HasClassicalAttributes field with no derivation; Dei Filius ch. 1, claim VATICAN-I-DEI-FILIUS-CH1-ONE-TRUE-LIVING-GOD, motivates the premise, and the absence of derivations of its further members is not evidence of failure). Bare-negation rivals (will, infinity, eternity, sufficiency): no typed vocabulary added. For will, infinity and eternity no replacement account with independent justification is on file, so typing one would add a placeholder; for sufficiency the gap is the undefined field. WARRANT SIDE: no root or act-of-being premise is stated by a sourced claim; 12 of the 14 attribute premises are (Aquinas; Aristotle and Aquinas for the act-potency non-overlap), which attributes them and their reasons to a text without establishing them; every stage-two premise except sufficiency has at least one verified derivation, all from other open premises. No premise is established, refuted or changed; no rival is established.
blocker: Unread leads, to be read before any weight is given: Meinong, Ueber Gegenstandstheorie section 3 (candidate MEINONG-GEGENSTANDSTHEORIE-3); Broad 1925 ch. 2 (candidate BROAD-MIND-AND-ITS-PLACE-CH2); Scotus, Quaest. Metaph. IX q.14 (candidate SCOTUS-QQ-METAPH-IX-Q14) and on the formal distinction; Aristotle Met. XII.7 (final cause only) and XII.9 (self-thinking first mover); Plotinus on necessary procession; Durandus on mere conservation; Spinoza, Ethics I; Shoemaker 1969, Time without change; Wolterstorff 1975, God everlasting; Hume's is/ought (Treatise III.1.1) and Moore's open question, as motivations of the goodness rival; anti-privation accounts of evil; Kenny 2002 on esse ipsum subsistens. Next tests: state (or reject) the sense bridge from DEF-PLOTINIAN-INTELLECT-DUALITY to stage two's HasIntellect; only if it holds, type the Plotinian rival of STMT-IMMATERIAL-IS-INTELLECTUAL and test it jointly against the simplicity and intellect conclusions; state the bridges that decide whether the read sources bear on their premises: facts and grounds of beings (Welchance), ungrounded and uncaused (Schaffer), concurrent sustenance and m.grounds (Schmid), ability and simple priority (Aristotle's aporia); define HasClassicalAttributes from Dei Filius ch. 1, so that sufficiency has a warrant beyond stipulation or can fail by derivation.
